description: Reads up to 25 emails (sender, subject, date and plain-text body) and picks out the ones that point to a train, flight or TfL claim: booking confirmations, delay and cancellation notices, airline schedule changes and denied boarding, TfL incomplete journey and maximum fare emails, and claim acknowledgements and decisions. Detection is by sender domain, subject pattern and fixed phrases, with no language model. For each match it returns the type, the signals that matched, the booking reference, dates, flight number, stations or airports, times and amounts it could read, a confidence level, a deadline hint, and the Untap check that fits with its arguments filled in and any missing ones listed. Emails with no signal are listed by position. Each body is read up to 20,000 characters. Nothing from the emails is stored; the usage record holds counts only. No sign-in needed.

emails.description: Up to 25 emails, each with its sender, subject, date and plain-text body.

body_text.description: The plain-text body. Only the first 20,000 characters are read.

date.description: When the email was sent: ISO 8601 or the raw Date header.

from.description: The From line as received, such as "Trainline <auto-confirm@info.thetrainline.com>".

name: scan_for_claims
title: Scan emails for train, flight and TfL claims
